vllm_upstream_base: vllm-project/vllm main between v0.33.0rc3 and v0.34.0; head of vllm-project/vllm PR #50496
rocm_base: Default: AMD's prebuilt rocm/vllm-dev:base, pinned by digest. Its labels list the same components as the pinned source's docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base. scripts/build.py --build-base builds that Dockerfile instead.

known_dependency_conflicts.reason: No Transformers revision matches both. The vLLM Apertus 1.5 code reads Apertus1p5Config.vision_tokenizer_config and audio_tokenizer_config; Swiss AI's July revision (5.14.0.dev0) has those names. The Apertus 1.5 model merged into huggingface/transformers on 2026-11-17 (65c782bca338, 5.24.0.dev0) renamed them to vision_config and audio_config and returns an output object from the vision tokenizer's encode(), so vLLM's code would fail to load the model with it, and 5.24 is also above vLLM's range.
known_dependency_conflicts.resolution: Allowed only for this one requirement in the image build. Re-pin both when Swiss AI updates PR #50496 to the merged Transformers model.

known_dependency_conflicts.installed: tokenizers 0.22.x (resolved from the pinned Transformers' range)
known_dependency_conflicts.reason: The pinned Transformers revision checks its dependency versions at import and raises ImportError with tokenizers 0.23.3 (requires >=0.22.0,<=0.23.0). vLLM's requirement is only declared metadata; with tokenizers 0.22.2 vLLM, the Apertus 1.5 model class, and the Apertus tool and reasoning parsers import and register (2026-11-18 trial in the built engine image).
known_dependency_conflicts.resolution: Allowed in the image build. Whether vLLM's tokenization path needs 0.23 is checked by the GPU serving test. Remove together with the Transformers conflict when re-pinning.
